verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's own docs describe asynchronous batch scraping of thousands of URLs, full-site crawls, and batch scrape jobs whose progress can be reported via webhooks. Together these directly support gathering data at scale with many parallel scrapes. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or controls, detail on running many parallel managed browser sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput at scale.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can spin up many concurrent scraping sessions to gather data at scale

citations.quote: Crawl an entire website and get content from all pages.
Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes.
